newFeatures: Session Financial Properties: View detailed money flow per session — including who attended with a discount, the center's revenue percentage, and the exact amount owed per student
Individual WhatsApp Messaging: Send personalized WhatsApp messages to individual students directly from the student profile
WhatsApp Template Variables: Added session notes and quiz notes as dynamic placeholders ({session_notes}, {quiz_notes}) in WhatsApp message templates
WhatsApp Template Sync: Templates are now synchronized across all devices via cloud sync, ensuring all assistants use the same messaging templates
Inactive Student Category: Students who have not attended for more than one month are automatically blocked and placed in a dedicated 'Inactive' category on the Students page
improvements: Auto-Block Invalid Parent Phones: Automatically blocks a parent's WhatsApp number if it has no WhatsApp account, is too short, or too long — preventing repeated failed send attempts
Attendance Date Validation: Prevents the last 2 sessions of a group from being scheduled for today's date, avoiding accidental duplicate sessions
Message Status Live Update: Message delivery status now updates in real-time without requiring the user to re-click or refresh the page
bugFixes: Fixed WhatsApp message status not refreshing automatically after sending
Fixed edge cases where inactive student auto-blocking could conflict with manual block operations
Fixed session financial calculations when discount overrides are applied mid-session
Fixed sending WhatsApp Announcment in the Bulck action
futureFeatures: Advanced Student Performance & Grade Analytics Dashboard
